paragraphs.raw_text: DOC_ID: ATL-0011 EVENT_ID: NONE TITLE: Country profile: Orvan SOURCE_NAME: Realm Trade Ministry SOURCE_TYPE: atlas RELIABILITY: 1 PUB_DATE: 2024-01-15 PUB_TIME: 11:30 COUNTRY: Orvan SECTOR: general LANGUAGE: en --- Country profile: Orvan

[P1] Orvan is a grain producer with a long coastline and a temperate interior. It grows wheat and maize on a large scale and also produces fertiliser, which is used at home and sold to neighbouring countries.

[P2] The main exports are wheat, maize and fertiliser. The country imports machinery and medicines. Orvan Grain Port is the principal export facility, with silos, bulk loaders and a separate berth for bagged fertiliser.
[P3] Corvan Grain, a grain exporter, is the best-known firm. The port is connected to the interior by road and a short rail spur, and smaller loading points serve growers in the coastal districts.
[P4] Grain is stored in silos at the port and at inland collection points. Smaller berths handle bagged fertiliser, and a coastal road links the port to nearby towns.
